name: FCC Install
author: mrnitro2017@gmail.com
description:
A powerful and lightweight Virtual Private Server (VPS) egg for Pterodactyl Panel.
See: https://github.com/ysdragon/Pterodactyl-VPS-Egg

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl tar xz-utils ca-certificates
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
  x86_64)  ARCH_ALT=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) ARCH_ALT=arm64 ;;
  riscv64) ARCH_ALT=riscv64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported arch $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
esac
BASE="https://images.linuxcontainers.org/images/ubuntu/noble/${ARCH_ALT}/default"
LATEST=$(curl -s "$BASE/" | grep -o '[0-9]\{8\}_[0-9]\{2\}:[0-9]\{2\}/' | sort -r | head -n 1)
echo "Using build: $LATEST"
curl -Ls "${BASE}/${LATEST}rootfs.tar.xz" -o rootfs.tar.xz
tar -xf rootfs.tar.xz -C /mnt/server
rm -f rootfs.tar.xz /mnt/server/etc/resolv.conf
mkdir -p /mnt/server/home/container

# Shell helpers from the upstream VPS egg (run.sh sources /common.sh).
UPSTREAM="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ysdragon/Pterodactyl-VPS-Egg/main/scripts"
curl -fLs "$UPSTREAM/common.sh" -o /mnt/server/common.sh

# run.sh and autorun.sh are versioned in the FCC_Egg repo. On every start autorun.sh
# compares that repo's VERSION with /.fcc-scripts-version and asks y/n before
# replacing both scripts, so the installed version is recorded here.
FCC_EGG_REF="${FCC_EGG_REF:-main}"
fetch_fcc() {  # fetch_fcc FILE DEST  -- from the FCC_Egg repo: GitHub API + token while the repo is private, raw download otherwise
  if [ -n "${FCC_GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    curl -fLs -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${FCC_GITHUB_TOKEN}" \
      "https://api.github.com/repos/llallenll/FCC_Egg/contents/$1?ref=${FCC_EGG_REF}" -o "$2"
  else
    curl -fLs "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llallenll/FCC_Egg/${FCC_EGG_REF}/$1" -o "$2"
  fi
}
echo "Fetching FCC scripts from llallenll/FCC_Egg (${FCC_EGG_REF})"
fetch_fcc run.sh     /mnt/server/run.sh
fetch_fcc autorun.sh /mnt/server/autorun.sh
fetch_fcc VERSION    /mnt/server/.fcc-scripts-version
chmod +x /mnt/server/run.sh /mnt/server/common.sh /mnt/server/autorun.sh
printf "nameserver 1.1.1.1\nnameserver 1.0.0.1\n" > /mnt/server/etc/resolv.conf

touch /mnt/server/.installed

variables.name: SCRIPT UPDATE PROMPT TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds autorun.sh waits at start for a y/n answer when a new version of run.sh/autorun.sh is found on GitHub. No answer = not updated this time (asked again next start). 0 = wait forever.

variables.name: SCRIPTS BRANCH
variables.description: Branch of the llallenll/FCC_Egg GitHub repo that run.sh, autorun.sh and VERSION are installed and updated from.

variables.name: GITHUB TOKEN (only if FCC_Egg is private)
variables.description: Leave empty if the llallenll/FCC_Egg repo is public. If it is private: a GitHub personal access token with read access to its contents, used to download run.sh, autorun.sh and VERSION at install and on every start.
